title: Pausekeeper
user: Solo narrators, game-stream commentators, and language teachers who want hands-free recording without recordings that chop natural speech pauses into awkward fragments.
smallest_useful_product: An offline-capable browser recorder with a visible voice/pause timeline, configurable minimum silence, post-record restore of held pauses, and WAV export.
monetization: freemium — local recording and WAV export are free; batch exports and reusable project presets are a one-time convenience unlock.
privacy: Microphone data remains in-browser by default; no accounts, transcription, or cloud audio upload.
